description: Composable Tone King Imperial MKII X starting points. Stack one recipe per useful layer, then adapt the result to the guitar, arrangement, and input level. Translated from packs/toneking/recipes.json: same controls, X's section names and stored units.

toneking.title: Dry Tone King factory baseline
toneking.use_when: starting from one of generate's Tone King factory baselines (clean or crunch): makes it dry, as it was measured
toneking.note: Reverb, delay, chorus and wah off, the amp's own reverb and tremolo depth at 0, the gate fully open (-96 dB), with the time-effects section itself on (so an effect turned back on is heard). The channel, amp, pedals, compressor, EQ, cab and rooms are kept. Stack it first; turn an effect back on afterwards only with its parameters set explicitly.

evidence.source: docs/toneking-baseline-results.md: the Tone King factory baselines were measured dry
